question.prompt:
The front view and left-side view of a building are both rectangles, and its top view is a circle. Which shape is the building most likely to have?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_291_q4_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: A circular top view and rectangular front and left-side views match a cylinder. A rectangular prism has a rectangular top view, a cone has a triangular front view, and a sphere has circular views from all three directions.
solutions.title: Match the three views
